_about: Stage 4 strategy. An angle = one segment + one insight + one promise standing on facts, in one format. Test different formats, not different words.

angles.insight: the true, specific thing about this segment's life the video starts from
angles.promise: what the viewer gets by watching (not what the product does)
angles.why_watch: why someone who has never heard of the product keeps watching after 2 s
hooks: three different openers, each a different mechanism (result first, stake, contradiction, POV)
